e-FAST
RMMCH EM Clinical Protocols V5 03/01/2024

FASTHUGS IN BED please
F
Fluids + Feeding
A
Analgesia
S
Sedation Skin + eye care
T
Thrombo-prophylaxis LMWH / flowtrons
H
Head up position 30-450 (if ventilated)
U
Ulcer prophylaxis especially if not fed
G
Glucose control HGTs regularly
S
Spontaneous Breathing Trial wean ventilation
I
Indwelling catheters Remove ASAP
N
Naso/orogastric tube
B
Bowel care 
E
Environment Temperature, delirium
D
De-escalation of therapy
please
Psychological support : Patient, Family, staff
Ref: Vincent JL. Give your patient a fast hug (at least) once a day. Crit CareMed 2005 33(6): 1225-1230
Nickson C LITFL 2020  https://litfl.com/fast-hugs-in-bed-please/
